title: Impact of a restructured patient education on the Comprehension, Awareness and patient satisfaction in the setting of pancREatic resection
summary:
Before pancreatic surgery, patient information is provided as standard in a continuous conversation without structured interruption. The information sheets are standardized, apply uniformly and show a clear picture of the gastrointestinal tract. The aim of the CARE study is to find out whether a newly structured briefing - with a short break - can also improve patient understanding of the procedure in pancreatic surgery.
It is a newly structured patient briefing with visual aids and a break of approx. 30 minutes to give patients sufficient time to process the information, identify ambiguities and allow for specific questions.

interventions.name: Intervention group: receives newly structured patient education with additional visual aids and a scheduled break of 30 minutes during consultation
Control group: patient briefing without scheduled break (standard briefing)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Indication for elective pancreatic head resection for malignant and benign tumors of the pancreas, distal bile duct, duodenum or chronic pancreatitis
- ASA I-III
Exclusion criteria:
- Emergency surgery
- Refusal to participate in the study
- Patient does not understand the content and purpose of the study due to language and/or cognitive barriers
